content:
I wanted to try and formalise the logarithmic power rule ($\log_a \left(x^n\right)= n \log_ax$) in Lean.

I tried to search for related content on this from the library/documentation repos I cloned locally, but got an overwhelming list of files in which logarithm is mentioned. I am still practicing Lean with the Natural Number Game, so I'm not quite proficient yet. Where would you start off if you wanted to do such a thing?
It depends on where you want to start, this is surely already in mathlib. A first thing you can do is to write a statement, with sorry as a proof.
